title: Evidence media formatting
responsibility: Determines supported media MIME/type labels and formats duration in seconds for display.

inputs.name: mediaMime.file
inputs.description: Filename whose final extension is checked case-insensitively.

inputs.name: evidenceMedia.item
inputs.description: Evidence with optional explicit media type and file address.

outputs.name: mediaMime
outputs.description: Known MIME type for supported image, audio, video and document extensions, otherwise application/octet-stream.

outputs.name: evidenceMedia
outputs.description: Explicit media type when present; otherwise audio for an audio extension or data:audio/ URL, and image for everything else.

outputs.name: formatDuration
outputs.description: Floored duration as minutes:seconds or hours:minutes:seconds. Empty for absent, negative or nonfinite values.
